page.layout: One block of running text, one column, no margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: iudicat antiquitas,ut Chryfostomus:Veritas magis elucet impugnata,ut Bernardus:Veritas nihil erubescit,nisi abscondi, ut Tertullianus: Contra veritatem cogni tam dimicare, idololatria superat [?], ut Augustinus pronunciavit.
5. Etsi magna est Satanae & satellitū illius licentia & sæuitia: nihil tamen aliud efficere poterunt, quàm quod, ut fieret, manus consiliūq; Dei decrevit. Act.4.28.

Ac non modò bona à bonis fiunt, Deo dā te ut velint & perficiant: sed etiam mala improborum hominum opera, ipsis-ne-scijs, seruire Dei judicijs necesse est. Lu-cet itaq; in bonis malisq; actionibus (sed ratione diversa) admirabilis Dei prov-identia.

6. Vera & æterna bona pis solis conferuntur: temporaria autem divinitus sic dispensantur, ut modicū quod habet ju-stus, præferri posit etiam Croesi opibus, quibus ἀθέοι [?] & improbi quidam interdū breui tempore potiuntur. Ac propitia Dei providentia interdum terrena & πρόσκαι-ρα bona nobis subducuntur, ne spinosa & noxia fiat: & ut ubertas ac plenitudo be-nedictionis spiritualis in nobis redun-det;

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "superat" (printed "fupetat", the word is not clear); "ἀθέοι" (accent and breathing not certain); "prov-identia" at the line end, the letters after "prou-" are faint. "cogni tam" stands at a line end with no printed hyphen; the word is probably cognitam, but I have copied it as printed. "habetiu-stus" is printed without a space between "habet" and "iustus". Printed in the margin: a short bracket or stroke mark beside the second line; it is not text. Show-through of text from the other side of the leaf is visible; it is not transcribed. Old spellings are kept as printed (pis, sæuitia, Act.4.28.); u/v and i/j are normalised as instructed.
